# mobix - Raspberry Pi Zero W, RAM-only, tuned for fast boot.
# https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/config_txt.html

# Cut-down GPU firmware: smaller to load, enough for a headless Linux boot
start_file=start_cd.elf
fixup_file=fixup_cd.dat
gpu_mem=16

kernel=zImage
# Whole rootfs is this initramfs; loaded right after the kernel
initramfs rootfs.cpio.lz4 followkernel

# Fast boot
boot_delay=0
disable_splash=1
initial_turbo=30
camera_auto_detect=0
display_auto_detect=0
disable_fw_kms_setup=1
hdmi_ignore_hotplug=1
hdmi_blanking=2

# Serial console on GPIO14/15 (PL011, Bluetooth disabled)
enable_uart=1
dtoverlay=disable-bt
# Timestamps from the firmware stage on UART, for boot-time measurement.
# Comment out once tuned.
uart_2ndstage=1

# USB OTG port in host mode for the printer
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host

# Faster SD access for the kernel (/boot mount)
dtparam=sd_overclock=50
